seo.title: Dornbracht Installation in Sunningdale | Fit-Only Bathroom Fitting | Install My Bathroom
seo.description: Dornbracht bath fillers and brassware positioned to the layout, fitted to the finish standard the brand demands, across Sunningdale. From £3,500.

hero.intro: Sunningdale's plots tend to be generous — large detached houses, many on private or gated roads around the golf courses the area is named for — which usually gives more flexibility on bathroom layout than a terraced or semi-detached property allows: moving a waste run three feet to fit a freestanding bath, for instance, is rarely blocked by a neighbouring wall. A Dornbracht floor-mounted or deck-mounted bath filler benefits from that flexibility, but the layout freedom doesn't soften the brand's finish sensitivity: Dornbracht is a German brassware house known for sculptural handle and spout design, in finishes that are genuinely difficult to replicate elsewhere, and a rough-in set a few millimetres out — or a scuff on a brushed Dark Platinum surface — is far more visible, and far more expensive to correct, than on a mainstream product. We install Dornbracht brassware fit-only across Sunningdale, positioning it exactly where the layout allows and protecting the finish through every later trade.

sections.heading: Positioning a Dornbracht bath filler on a generous plot
sections.body: On a Sunningdale property with room to move a waste run, a Dornbracht bath filler can usually go exactly where the layout calls for it, rather than where existing pipework happens to allow. That's useful, but it raises the stakes on getting the position right: once a floor-mounted or deck-mounted filler is set and the surrounding stone or tiling is in, moving it again means reopening finished work. We confirm the exact position against the bath and the Dornbracht spec at survey stage, before any pipework is first-fixed.

sections.heading: Why the finish needs protecting, not just the plumbing
sections.body: Fitting Dornbracht brassware doesn't call for different plumbing skills to any mainstream brand — what changes is what a mistake costs. A scuff on a brushed Dark Platinum finish or a rough-in set a few millimetres out is far more visible, and far more expensive to put right, than the same slip on a standard product. On a Sunningdale installation, that means sequencing the fit so finished brassware goes in late in the programme, after the risk of knocks from tiling and other trades has largely passed.

sections.heading: Working around Sunningdale's private and gated roads
sections.body: A number of Sunningdale properties sit on private or gated roads, which we factor into scheduling access for deliveries and the fitting programme — a logistics detail separate from the installation itself, but one that matters for keeping a Dornbracht fit-out running to plan once materials and brassware are on site. A floor-mounted or deck-mounted Dornbracht filler in particular tends to arrive as a larger, more delicate boxed item than a standard mixer tap, so we confirm delivery windows and who's receiving it on a gated road before the item is despatched, rather than leaving it unattended at a gate.

sections.heading: Fit-only, Dornbracht included
sections.body: We work fit-only across Sunningdale: you source your Dornbracht brassware through a showroom or retailer, and we strip out, first-fix, plumb, tile-coordinate and snag, from £3,500. A £125 survey comes first, where we confirm the exact bath filler or tap position against the layout freedom a Sunningdale plot allows. With 30 years' experience, getting that position right the first time is the difference between a straightforward fit and an expensive rework.

faqs.q: Can a Dornbracht bath filler be positioned anywhere I want on a larger Sunningdale plot?
faqs.a: Generally yes — a larger plot gives more freedom to move a waste run than a terraced property would allow — but we confirm the exact position at survey stage before any pipework is first-fixed, since moving it later means reopening finished work.

faqs.q: Why does a rough-in error cost more to fix with Dornbracht than a mainstream brand?
faqs.a: Dornbracht's finishes, such as brushed Dark Platinum, are genuinely difficult to replicate elsewhere, so a mis-set rough-in or a scuffed finish is far more visible and costlier to correct than on a standard product.

faqs.q: Do you handle access on Sunningdale's private and gated roads?
faqs.a: Yes — we factor private and gated road access into scheduling deliveries and the fitting programme, so the Dornbracht installation itself isn't held up by logistics.

faqs.q: Do I buy the Dornbracht bath filler myself, or do you supply it?
faqs.a: You supply it. We work fit-only, so you source the product and we handle installation, from £3,500.
